reviews.text: I’ll be deleting this app as soon as I can migrate my mom to an app that doesn’t use such egregious advertising tactics. reviews.title: Great trivia game
reviews.text:
Great trivia game, love the format, variety of topics. I recommend it for those who love trivia. 

With that said, one thing to improve: game freezes making me restart in order to unfreeze, and lose opportunity to answer the remaining questions. It just happened today. Maybe the new update would fix it. 

Otherwise - totally enjoy it! Thank you!

Update: I don’t know how you check your answers for accuracy. I see a lot of errors. It’s a great game but you guys have to do something about the accuracy. I see them every day, sometimes a few times a day. Take your time to verify. It’s annoying to be honest with you.

reviews.text:
Loved this game for a long time but recent changes have ruined it. There is now no way to stop playing with a particular opponent; the game just keeps creating another round for you with the person you just finished with. 

They have responsive support but they tell me that this continuous loop is not happening - but it is. 

Sorry to have to quit. Anyone know of another good trivia game?

reviews.title: Only ONE Thing…
reviews.text: So this app is actually REALLY well-made. It’s a lot of fun, has tons of questions, and it’s easy to connect with friends and it’s entirely free. That’s hard to come by nowadays. The question variety is also great as well. HOWEVER, when I go to click on a friend’s profile just to check our game score and see our record, it “nudges” them and notifies them. It’s happened to me a few times and it’s quick to blow up my phone. That’s the one thing I’d “fix” because I’d just like to check our scores without nudging them and blowing up THEIR phone. Otherwise, it’s a lot of fun and totally recommended. I’d just change that one design in the game so I’m not annoying friends or getting tons of notifications.

reviews.title: No stats, very little history
reviews.text:
The mechanics of the game are great, and the questions are good, but I seem to have absolutely no stats on how well I’ve done historically, or what the strength of other players are. It’s just play a person; it will track wins, draws, and losses against that person; and you have a view of the last several games you’ve played. That’s it.

Also, I hate the concept of “watch a video to get a second chance” at a question. I’d prefer the gameplay be the gameplay when playing against actual other people. 

 I will say, in response to another review, I have no problem exiting the occasional ad. The little white X is there in the corner, you just have to click on it.
